name: Jest of the Twisting Highway
body:
School: illusion; Level: jester 4

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range: personal

Target: you

Duration: 1 round

DESCRIPTION

You become invisible until the start of your next turn or until you make an attack.
